WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(p_query, $16)), $17) AS query_text,
    CASE COALESCE(p_position, $18)
      WHEN $19 THEN ARRAY[]::text[]
      WHEN $20 THEN ARRAY[$21, $22]::text[]
      WHEN $23 THEN ARRAY[$24, $25]::text[]
      ELSE ARRAY[p_position]::text[]
    END AS pos_filter,
    CASE
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, $26)) > $27 THEN
          ARRAY(
            SELECT explicit_team
            FROM unnest(COALESCE(p_teams, $28)) AS explicit_team
            WHERE explicit_team = ANY(COALESCE(p_playing_teams, $29))
            ORDER BY explicit_team
          )
      WHEN p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p_playing_teams, $30)
      ELSE COALESCE(p_teams, $31)
    END AS effective_teams,
    (p_playing_teams IS NOT NULL OR cardinality(COALESCE(p_teams, $32)) > $33) AS team_filter_active,
    COALESCE(p_excluded_teams, $34) AS excluded_teams,
    COALESCE(p_exclude_player_ids, $35) AS exclude_player_ids,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, $36), $37), $38) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, $39), $40) AS page_offset
),
league_scores AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = p_season_year
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR fp.player_id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
),
score_source AS (
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM public.v_player_avg_fantasy_points AS fp
  WHERE fp.league_id = p_league_id
    AND fp.season_year = p_season_year
    AND NOT COALESCE(p_health IN ($41, $42, $43, $44), $45)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT fp.player_id, fp.avg_fantasy_points
  FROM league_scores AS fp
  WHERE p_health IN ($46, $47, $48, $49)
),
filtered_base AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws($50, p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.status,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id,
    p.years_exp,
    fp.avg_fantasy_points,
    avg.avg_points,
    avg.avg_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists,
    avg.avg_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks,
    avg.avg_turnovers,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_minutes_played,
    avg.games_played::int AS games_played
  FROM args
  JOIN public.players AS p ON $51
  LEFT JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages AS avg
    ON avg.player_id = p.id
   AND avg.season_year = p_season_year
  LEFT JOIN score_source AS fp
    ON fp.player_id = p.id
  WHERE
    (args.query_text IS NULL OR p.display_name ILIKE ($52 || args.query_text || $53))
    AND (cardinality(args.pos_filter) = $54 OR EXISTS (
      SELECT $55
      FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS player_position
      WHERE player_position::text = ANY(args.pos_filter)
    ))
    AND (NOT args.team_filter_active OR (cardinality(args.effective_teams) > $56 AND p.nba_team = ANY(args.effective_teams)))
    AND (cardinality(args.excluded_teams) = $57 OR p.nba_team IS NULL OR p.nba_team <> ALL(args.excluded_teams))
    AND (p_include_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_include_player_ids))
    AND (cardinality(args.exclude_player_ids) = $58 OR p.id <> ALL(args.exclude_player_ids))
    AND (NOT p_rookies_only OR p.years_exp = $59)
    AND CASE COALESCE(p_health, $60)
      WHEN $61 THEN p.injury_status IS NULL
      WHEN $62 THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY[$63, $64, $65, $66])
      WHEN $67 THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY[$68, $69, $70])
      WHEN $71 THEN p.injury_status = ANY(ARRAY[$72, $73])
      ELSE $74
    END
),
paged_base AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      filtered_base.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        ORDER BY
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $75 AND p_sort_dir = $76 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points, $77) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $78 AND p_sort_dir <> $79 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_fantasy_points, $80) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $81 AND p_sort_dir = $82 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_minutes_played, $83) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $84 AND p_sort_dir <> $85 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_minutes_played, $86) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $87 AND p_sort_dir = $88 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_points, $89) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $90 AND p_sort_dir <> $91 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_points, $92) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $93 AND p_sort_dir = $94 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, $95) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $96 AND p_sort_dir <> $97 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_rebounds, $98) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $99 AND p_sort_dir = $100 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, $101) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $102 AND p_sort_dir <> $103 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_assists, $104) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $105 AND p_sort_dir = $106 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, $107) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $108 AND p_sort_dir <> $109 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_steals, $110) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $111 AND p_sort_dir = $112 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, $113) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $114 AND p_sort_dir <> $115 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_blocks, $116) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $117 AND p_sort_dir = $118 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, $119) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $120 AND p_sort_dir <> $121 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_three_pointers_made, $122) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $123 AND p_sort_dir = $124 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, $125) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $126 AND p_sort_dir <> $127 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.avg_turnovers, $128) END DESC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $129 AND p_sort_dir = $130 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, $131) END ASC,
          CASE WHEN p_sort_by = $132 AND p_sort_dir <> $133 THEN COALESCE(filtered_base.games_played, $134) END DESC,
          filtered_base.display_name ASC,
          filtered_base.id ASC
      ) AS page_rank
    FROM filtered_base
  ) ranked_base
  ORDER BY page_rank
  LIMIT (SELECT page_limit FROM args)
  OFFSET (SELECT page_offset FROM args)
),
projection AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.get_league_projection_rows(
    p_league_id,
    p_season_year,
    (timezone($135, now()))::date,
    $136,
    COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(paged_base.id ORDER BY paged_base.id) FROM paged_base), ARRAY[]::uuid[]),
    (SELECT page_limit FROM args),
    $137
  )
  WHERE p_league_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  pb.id,
  pb.display_name,
  pb.nba_team,
  pb."position",
  pb.eligible_positions,
  pb.status,
  pb.injury_status,
  pb.headshot_url,

  pb.avg_steals,
  pb.avg_blocks,

  pb.avg_three_pointers_made,
  pb.avg_minutes_played,
  pb.games_played,

  proj.projection_source_label,
  proj.projection_view,
  proj.projection_fetched_at,
  proj.projection_date,

  proj.projection_steals,
  proj.projection_blocks,
  proj.projection_three_pointers_made,
  proj.projection_turnovers,
  proj.projection_status
FROM paged_base pb
LEFT JOIN projection AS proj
  ON proj.player_id = pb.id
ORDER BY pb.page_rank
SELECT private.reconcile_edge_invocations() FROM generate_series($1,$2)

SELECT inv.*, resp.status_code AS response_status, resp.error_msg, resp.timed_out,
           left(resp.content, $1) AS content
      FROM public.edge_invocations AS inv
      LEFT JOIN net._http_response AS resp ON resp.id = inv.request_id
     WHERE inv.reconciled_at IS NULL AND inv.queued_at < now() - interval $2
     ORDER BY inv.queued_at LIMIT $3 FOR UPDATE OF inv SKIP LOCKED
SELECT public.invoke_live_poll_if_due() FROM generate_series($1,$2)
EXISTS (SELECT $1 FROM public.get_live_poll_work())

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN p_view IN ($8, $9, $10) THEN p_view ELSE $11 END AS view_name,
    COALESCE(p_game_date, (timezone($12, now()))::date) AS game_date,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, $13), $14), $15) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, $16), $17) AS page_offset
),
league AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    scoring_settings,
    (
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>$18)::numeric, $19) <> $20 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>$21)::numeric, $22) <> $23 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>$24)::numeric, $25) <> $26 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>$27)::numeric, $28) <> $29
    ) AS uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  FROM public.leagues
  WHERE id = p_league_id
),
week_ctx AS (
  SELECT sw.week_number, sw.week_start, sw.week_end
  FROM args
  JOIN public.season_weeks sw
    ON sw.season_year = p_season_year
   AND sw.week_start <= args.game_date
   AND sw.week_end >= args.game_date
  LIMIT $30
),
base_players AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws($31, p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id
  FROM public.players p
  WHERE p_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_player_ids)
),
team_next_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT teams.nba_team, g.game_date, g.home_team, g.away_team, g.game_time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT nba_team FROM base_players WHERE nba_team IS NOT NULL) teams
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ng.game_date, ng.home_team, ng.away_team, ng.game_time
    FROM args
    JOIN public.nba_games ng
      ON ng.season_year = p_season_year
     AND ng.game_date >= args.game_date
     AND ng.status NOT IN ($32, $33)
     AND (ng.game_time IS NULL OR ng.game_time > now())
     AND (ng.started_at IS NULL OR ng.started_at > now())
     AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(ng.nba_game_id)
     AND (ng.home_team = teams.nba_team OR ng.away_team = teams.nba_team)
    ORDER BY ng.game_date ASC, ng.game_time ASC NULLS LAST, ng.id ASC
    LIMIT $34
  ) g ON $35
),
next_games AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    g.game_date AS next_game_date,
    CASE
      WHEN g.home_team = bp.nba_team THEN $36 || COALESCE(g.away_team, $37)
      WHEN g.away_team = bp.nba_team THEN $38 || COALESCE(g.home_team, $39)
      ELSE $40
    END AS next_game_opponent,
    g.game_time AS next_game_time
  FROM base_players bp
  LEFT JOIN team_next_games g ON g.nba_team = bp.nba_team
),
week_game_counts AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    COUNT(ng.id)::int AS scheduled_games
  FROM base_players bp
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON $41
  JOIN public.nba_games ng
    ON ng.season_year = p_season_year
   AND ng.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(ng.nba_game_id)
   AND bp.nba_team IS NOT NULL
   AND (ng.home_team = bp.nba_team OR ng.away_team = bp.nba_team)
  GROUP BY bp.id
),
latest_daily_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $42
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $43
   AND latest_run.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND latest_run.status = $44
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $45
),
latest_weekly_avg_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $46
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $47
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $48
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = $49
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $50
),
latest_weekly_total_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $51
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $52
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $53
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = $54
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $55
),
daily_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    $56::text AS projection_source,
    $57::text AS projection_source_label,
    $58::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      $59::numeric, $60::numeric, $61::numeric, $62::numeric, $63::numeric, $64::numeric,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $65 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $66 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $67
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = $68
   AND r.match_status = $69
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval $70
  JOIN latest_daily_run ldr
    ON ldr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = $71
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = $72
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $73 THEN $74
      ELSE $75
    END::text AS projection_source,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $76 THEN $77
      ELSE $78
    END::text AS projection_source_label,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $79 THEN $80
      ELSE $81
    END::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points * m.games_multiplier,
      r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      r.assists * m.games_multiplier,
      r.steals * m.games_multiplier,
      r.blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      $82::numeric,
      $83::numeric,
      $84::numeric,
      $85::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $86 AND m.games_multiplier > $87 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $88) >= $89)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $90) >= $91)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $92) >= $93)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $94) >= $95)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $96) >= $97)::int
        ) >= $98 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = $99 THEN $100::numeric
        ELSE $101::numeric
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $102 AND m.games_multiplier > $103 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $104) >= $105)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $106) >= $107)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $108) >= $109)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $110) >= $111)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $112) >= $113)::int
        ) >= $114 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = $115 THEN $116::numeric
        ELSE $117::numeric
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    r.points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    r.steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $118 THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE r.games_played END AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $119 AS projection_is_fresh,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $120 THEN $121 ELSE $122 END AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $123
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $124
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = $125
   AND r.match_status = $126
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval $127
  JOIN latest_weekly_avg_run lwar
    ON lwar.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = $128
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = r.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $129 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(r.games_played, $130), wgc.scheduled_games, $131)::numeric
      ELSE $132::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  WHERE args.view_name IN ($133, $134, $135)
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_total_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    $136::text AS projection_source,
    $137::text AS projection_source_label,
    $138::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      $139::numeric, $140::numeric, $141::numeric, $142::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, $143) > $144 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $145) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $146) >= $147)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $148) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $149) >= $150)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $151) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $152) >= $153)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $154) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $155) >= $156)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $157) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $158) >= $159)::int
        ) >= $160 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE $161
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, $162) > $163 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $164) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $165) >= $166)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $167) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $168) >= $169)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $170) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $171) >= $172)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $173) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $174) >= $175)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $176) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $177) >= $178)::int
        ) >= $179 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE $180
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $181 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $182 AS priority
  FROM args

    $200::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    $201::text AS projection_status,
    pp.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    $202::date AS projection_date,

    $203 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $204 AS priority

  JOIN league l ON $206

season_avg_candidates AS (

  JOIN league l ON $234

    AND EXISTS (SELECT $237 FROM public.nba_games g WHERE g.season_year=p_season_year
      AND g.game_date=r.game_date AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(g.nba_game_id)
      AND (g.home_team=r.team AND g.away_team=r.opponent OR g.away_team=r.team AND g.home_team=r.opponent))
    AND (args.view_name = $238 AND r.game_date = COALESCE(ng.next_game_date,args.game_date)

sleeper_totals AS (

    sum(points) AS points, sum(rebounds) AS rebounds, sum(assists) AS assists,
    sum(steals) AS steals, sum(blocks) AS blocks, sum(three_pointers_made) AS three_pointers_made,
    sum(turnovers) AS turnovers, sum(minutes) AS minutes,
    $240 * sum(field_goals_made) / NULLIF(sum(field_goals_attempted),$241) AS field_goal_pct,
    $242 * sum(free_throws_made) / NULLIF(sum(free_throws_attempted),$243) AS free_throw_pct,
    max(fetched_at) AS fetched_at, min(game_date) AS game_date, min(week_number) AS week_number
  FROM sleeper_games GROUP BY player_id

sleeper_candidates AS (
  SELECT s.player_id, $244::text AS projection_source, $245::text AS projection_source_label,
    args.view_name AS projection_view,
    ROUND((s.fantasy_points + COALESCE(b.projection_fantasy_points * m.missing_fraction,$246)) / m.divisor,$247) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    (s.minutes + COALESCE(b.projection_minutes * m.missing_fraction,$248)) / m.divisor AS projection_minutes,
    (s.points + COALESCE(b.projection_points * m.missing_fraction,$249)) / m.divisor AS projection_points,
    (s.rebounds + COALESCE(b.projection_rebounds * m.missing_fraction,$250)) / m.divisor AS projection_rebounds,
    (s.assists + COALESCE(b.projection_assists * m.missing_fraction,$251)) / m.divisor AS projection_assists,
    (s.steals + COALESCE(b.projection_steals * m.missing_fraction,$252)) / m.divisor AS projection_steals,
    (s.blocks + COALESCE(b.projection_blocks * m.missing_fraction,$253)) / m.divisor AS projection_blocks,
    (s.three_pointers_made + COALESCE(b.projection_three_pointers_made * m.missing_fraction,$254)) / m.divisor AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    (s.turnovers + COALESCE(b.projection_turnovers * m.missing_fraction,$255)) / m.divisor AS projection_turnovers,
    s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $256 END AS projection_games_played,
    (COALESCE(s.field_goal_pct,$257)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_field_goal_pct,$258)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_field_goal_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $259 END,$260) AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    (COALESCE(s.free_throw_pct,$261)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_free_throw_pct,$262)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_free_throw_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $263 END,$264) AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    $265::text AS projection_status, s.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name=$266 THEN s.game_date ELSE $267::date END AS projection_date,
    s.week_number AS projection_week_number, s.fetched_at>=now()-interval $268 AS projection_is_fresh, $269 AS priority
  FROM sleeper_totals s CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN fallback_best b ON b.player_id=s.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc ON wgc.player_id=s.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN args.view_name=$270 THEN $271 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games,$272)+s.prior_team_games-s.games,$273) END AS missing_games
  ) missing
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT missing.missing_games,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name=$274 THEN missing.missing_games::numeric / NULLIF(b.projection_games_played,$275)
        ELSE missing.missing_games::numeric END AS missing_fraction,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name=$276 THEN s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN missing.missing_games ELSE $277 END
        ELSE $278 END::numeric AS divisor
  ) m
),

WITH
base_types AS (
  SELECT t.oid, bt.typnamespace AS base_namespace, bt.oid AS base_type
  FROM pg_type t
  JOIN pg_type bt ON bt.oid = pg_basetype(t.oid)
),
arguments AS (
  SELECT
    oid,
    array_agg((
      COALESCE(name, ''), -- name
      type::regtype::text, -- type
      CASE type
        WHEN 'bit'::regtype THEN 'bit varying'
        WHEN 'bit[]'::regtype THEN 'bit varying[]'
        WHEN 'character'::regtype THEN 'character varying'
        WHEN 'character[]'::regtype THEN 'character varying[]'
        ELSE type::regtype::text
      END, -- convert types that ignore the length and accept any value till maximum size
      idx <= (pronargs - pronargdefaults), -- is_required
      COALESCE(mode = 'v', FALSE) -- is_variadic
    ) ORDER BY idx) AS args,
    CASE COUNT(*) - COUNT(name) -- number of unnamed arguments
      WHEN 0 THEN true
      WHEN 1 THEN (array_agg(type))[1] IN ('bytea'::regtype, 'json'::regtype, 'jsonb'::regtype, 'text'::regtype, 'xml'::regtype)
      ELSE false
    END AS callable
  FROM pg_proc,
       unnest(proargnames, proargtypes, proargmodes)
         WITH ORDINALITY AS _ (name, type, mode, idx)
  WHERE type IS NOT NULL -- only input arguments
  GROUP BY oid
)
SELECT
  pn.nspname AS proc_schema,
  p.proname AS proc_name,
  d.description AS proc_description,
  COALESCE(a.args, '{}') AS args,
  tn.nspname AS schema,
  COALESCE(comp.relname, t.typname) AS name,
  p.proretset AS rettype_is_setof,
  (t.typtype = 'c'
   -- if any TABLE, INOUT or OUT arguments present, treat as composite
   or COALESCE(proargmodes::text[] && '{t,b,o}', false)
  ) AS rettype_is_composite,
  bt.oid <> bt.base_type as rettype_is_composite_alias,
  p.provolatile,
  p.provariadic > 0 as hasvariadic,
  (regexp_split_to_array((regexp_split_to_array(iso_config, '='))[2], ','))[1] AS transaction_isolation_level,
  coalesce(func_settings.kvs, '{}') as kvs
FROM pg_proc p
LEFT JOIN arguments a ON a.oid = p.oid
JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid = p.pronamespace
JOIN base_types bt ON bt.oid = p.prorettype
JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = bt.base_type
JOIN pg_namespace tn ON tn.oid = t.typnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_class comp ON comp.oid = t.typrelid
LEFT JOIN pg_description as d ON d.objoid = p.oid AND d.classoid = 'pg_proc'::regclass
LEFT JOIN LATERAL unnest(proconfig) iso_config ON iso_config LIKE 'default_transaction_isolation%'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    array_agg(row(
      substr(setting, 1, strpos(setting, '=') - 1),
      substr(setting, strpos(setting, '=') + 1)
    )) as kvs
  FROM unnest(proconfig) setting
  WHERE setting ~ ANY($2)
) func_settings ON TRUE
WHERE t.oid <> 'trigger'::regtype AND COALESCE(a.callable, true)
AND prokind = 'f'
AND p.pronamespace = ANY($1::regnamespace[])

with
all_relations as (

  where typname = $7
),
media_types as (
    SELECT
      t.oid,
      lower(t.typname) as typname,
      t.typnamespace,
      case t.typname
        when $8 then $9
        else t.typname
      end as resolved_media_type
    FROM pg_type t
    JOIN pg_type b ON t.typbasetype = b.oid
    WHERE
      t.typbasetype <> $10 and
      (t.typname ~* $11 or t.typname = $12)

  join pg_proc      proc         on proc.prorettype = media_types.oid
  join pg_namespace proc_schema  on proc_schema.oid = proc.pronamespace
  join pg_aggregate agg          on agg.aggfnoid = proc.oid

WITH changed AS (SELECT n.*,$1 AS sign FROM totals_new_rows n LEFT JOIN totals_old_rows o USING(id)
    WHERE o.id IS NULL OR (to_jsonb(n)-$2) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(o)-$3)
    UNION ALL SELECT o.*,$4 AS sign FROM totals_old_rows o LEFT JOIN totals_new_rows n USING(id)
    WHERE n.id IS NULL OR (to_jsonb(n)-$5) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(o)-$6)), grouped AS (
      SELECT s.player_id,s.season_year,s.sign,
      count(*)::bigint AS games_played,

      COALESCE(sum(s.defensive_rebounds),$11) AS defensive_rebounds, count(s.defensive_rebounds)::bigint AS defensive_rebounds_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.assists),$12) AS assists, count(s.assists)::bigint AS assists_count,

      COALESCE(sum(s.blocks),$14) AS blocks, count(s.blocks)::bigint AS blocks_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.turnovers),$15) AS turnovers, count(s.turnovers)::bigint AS turnovers_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.personal_fouls),$16) AS personal_fouls, count(s.personal_fouls)::bigint AS personal_fouls_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.field_goals_made),$17) AS field_goals_made, count(s.field_goals_made)::bigint AS field_goals_made_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.field_goals_attempted),$18) AS field_goals_attempted, count(s.field_goals_attempted)::bigint AS field_goals_attempted_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.three_pointers_made),$19) AS three_pointers_made, count(s.three_pointers_made)::bigint AS three_pointers_made_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.three_pointers_attempted),$20) AS three_pointers_attempted, count(s.three_pointers_attempted)::bigint AS three_pointers_attempted_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.free_throws_made),$21) AS free_throws_made, count(s.free_throws_made)::bigint AS free_throws_made_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.free_throws_attempted),$22) AS free_throws_attempted, count(s.free_throws_attempted)::bigint AS free_throws_attempted_count,
      COALESCE(sum(s.plus_minus),$23) AS plus_minus, count(s.plus_minus)::bigint AS plus_minus_count,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.double_double)::bigint AS double_double,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.triple_double)::bigint AS triple_double
      FROM changed s JOIN public.nba_games g ON g.id=s.game_id
      WHERE NOT s.did_not_play AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(g.nba_game_id)
